meta.name: alfworld-storage-explorer
meta.description: Systematically explores storage receptacles (drawers, cabinets, shelves) to find an appropriate placement location for an object. Use when the agent needs to store an item but the exact target receptacle is unknown or ambiguous. Opens, inspects, and closes candidate receptacles to assess suitability, then places the object in the best match.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动探索容器并存放物品到合适位置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在未知位置自动存放物品。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically explore containers and place items in suitable locations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically store items in unknown locations.

howto.what: 这个技能会让Claude自动探索抽屉、柜子等储物容器，找到最合适的放置位置。它会打开、检查、关闭容器，评估后把物品放好。
howto.when: 当你要存放某个物品，但不清楚具体该放哪个抽屉或柜子时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个杯子放到合适的柜子里。
say.note: Claude会探索柜子并找到最佳位置。

say.text: 找个抽屉把这个文件夹放进去。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude systematically explore storage containers like drawers and cabinets to find the best placement. It opens, inspects, and closes containers, then places the item appropriately.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to store an item but the exact target container is unknown or ambiguous.

say_en.text: Put this cup in a suitable cabinet.
say_en.note: Claude will explore cabinets and pick the best spot.

say_en.text: Find a drawer for this folder.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect drawers before placing.
